title: Toward Structure Fairness in Dynamic Graph Embedding: A Trend-aware Dual Debiasing Approach

problem.claim: Dynamic graph embedding must address effectiveness disparities between structurally different vertex groups while accounting for evolving vertex degrees.

gap.claim: Achieving structure fairness in dynamic graph embedding remains an open problem.

contributions.claim: FairDGE identifies biased structural evolutions from evolving vertex-degree trends and jointly embeds connection changes with long- and short-term degree evolution.
A dual debiasing approach encodes fair embeddings contrastively and customizes debiasing strategies for different biased structural evolutions.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that the debiasing strategy breaks the embedding effectiveness bottleneck without notable fairness loss.
The authors report that extensive experiments show simultaneous improvement in embedding effectiveness and fairness.

narrative_sequence.summary: Static graph embeddings have addressed structural fairness by reducing effectiveness disparities between high- and low-degree vertex groups.
Structure fairness in dynamic graph embedding remains unresolved, and ignoring degree changes can impair effectiveness without substantially improving fairness.
FairDGE models biased structural evolution using degree trends and changing connections.
FairDGE applies contrastive dual debiasing strategies tailored to different structural evolutions.
The authors report improved effectiveness and fairness without notable fairness loss.

source_observation.claim: Ignoring degree changes in dynamic graphs can reduce embedding effectiveness while providing little fairness benefit.

interpretation.claim: Fairness interventions in evolving graphs should model structural change rather than rely only on static degree categories.

application.claim: For dynamic graph representation systems, incorporate vertex-degree trends and connection changes into fairness-aware training.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this principle generalizes beyond the reported dynamic graph embedding setting.

source_observation.claim: The approach customizes debiasing strategies for different biased structural evolutions.

interpretation.claim: Fairness mechanisms may need to distinguish among types of structural evolution instead of applying one uniform correction.

application.claim: Design fairness objectives or debiasing modules conditional on identifiable evolution patterns.

exception.claim: The abstract does not specify the evolution categories, debiasing details, or conditions under which each strategy applies.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify datasets, baselines, metrics, numerical results, or experimental conditions.
The abstract does not define the fairness and effectiveness measures.
The abstract does not provide implementation details or computational requirements.
